code: import{PRIZES,MILESTONES}from'./data';export const calcPrize=(correctCount,reason)=>{if(reason==='Bạn đã dừng cuộc chơi')return correctCount>0?PRIZES[correctCount-1]:0;if(correctCount===15)return PRIZES[14];const passedMilestones=MILESTONES.filter(m=>m<=correctCount);if(passedMilestones.length===0)return 0;return PRIZES[passedMilestones[passedMilestones.length-1]-1];};
